per_credit_hour_charges.line: Get a “jump” start on college through EAC’s Dual/Concurrent Programs. Reduced tuition for enrolled high school students – $70 per credit!
Register & Pay for classes in eac.edu/MyEAC/ – $70 per credit OR  at EAC’s Business Administration Division in the Student Services Building
• Tuition for courses is $70 per credit. Some courses may have an additional lab or course fee.
